name: Rishi Singh
current_role: Co-founder & board member, Harness; founder & CEO, SapientAI / BaseRock.ai (AI software testing)
profile: IIT Delhi-trained engineer who spent five years at Apple leading its deployment-automation platform, then co-founded Harness (AI software delivery platform) with Jyoti Bansal and served as CTO until 2021. He remains on Harness's board and now runs an AI test-generation startup (SapientAI, launched May 2023 with $5M seed from 8VC; BaseRock.ai).
interesting_fact: SapientAI emerged from stealth in May 2023 with a $5M seed led by 8VC to build an 'AI Test Coder' that writes unit tests automatically.
deep_cut_fact: Before Harness he spent five years at Apple leading development of its internal deployment automation platform, and says he learned from Steve Jobs the importance of constantly talking about what you believe in.
notes: Not the founder-CEO of Harness (that is Jyoti Bansal); he is the technical co-founder. Best route likely via his current AI-testing startup.

name: Garrett Lord
profile: Michigan native who co-founded Handshake, the college career network, in 2014 with Michigan Tech classmates Ben Christensen and Scott Ringwelski, leaving school a few credits short to raise capital. Handshake was valued at $3.5B (Series F, 2022). Since late 2024 he has pushed a 'refounding' via Handshake AI, which recruits domain experts to train AI models.
interesting_fact: He conceived Handshake AI at the company's 2024 Christmas party; the unit was projected to hit about $100M in annual recurring revenue, and he calls the pivot the 'refounding of Handshake'.
deep_cut_fact: At Michigan Tech he worked as a ski patroller at Mont Ripley, played broomball, and scavenged campus dumpsters for parts for his IT side business; he also cold-emailed recruiters to land a Palantir internship and won its summer hackathon.

public_contacts.value: Notion 'First Block' interview with Garrett Lord

notes: Very accessible founder with lots of interviews; Handshake AI (data-for-AI) angle relevant to a data-center/AI podcast.

name: Laura Spiekerman
current_role: Co-founder & President, Alloy (identity and fraud prevention platform)
profile: Fintech operator who co-founded Alloy in 2015 with Tommy Nicholas and Charles Hearn after the three met at an ACH payments startup. Alloy provides identity verification, KYC/AML and fraud-prevention tooling to 900+ banks, credit unions and fintechs and was valued at about $1.55B in 2021. She serves as President and leads go-to-market and partnerships.
interesting_fact: Alloy's platform is used by over 900 banks, credit unions and fintechs to manage identity, KYC/AML compliance and fraud risk.
deep_cut_fact: Before Alloy she was the first hire at Kenyan payments company Kopo Kopo, where watching M-Pesa 'change people's financial lives' drew her to financial infrastructure.
notes: Some profiles list her as CRO or COO; Alloy's own site says President. Frequent fintech conference speaker.

name: Sujay Tyle
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, Merama (Latin American e-commerce brand builder/aggregator)
profile: US-born serial founder who entered Harvard at 15, left as a 2011 Thiel Fellow, and worked at Scopely before moving to Berlin to co-found Frontier Car Group (emerging-market used-car marketplaces), acquired by OLX/Naspers in 2019. He then co-founded Merama, which acquires and scales consumer brands selling on Mercado Libre and Amazon across Latin America, reaching unicorn status.
interesting_fact: He was a freshman at Harvard by age 15 and left in his junior year to become one of Peter Thiel's original '20 Under 20' fellows.
deep_cut_fact: In 2008, as a teenager, he co-founded ReSight with his older brother Sheel, a venture aimed at democratizing eye-care services.
notes: No published personal/press contact found; Merama's website has no press email. Route via Merama or Frontier Car Group investors.

name: Rob Forman
current_role: CEO coach (listed with Scalebound); independent board member (e.g., Grayscale); co-founder & former President, Salesloft
profile: Atlanta software engineer-turned-founder who co-founded Salesloft, the sales engagement platform, serving as head of technology and later President & Chief Strategy Officer. Vista Equity Partners acquired Salesloft in December 2021 for $2.3B. He now coaches CEOs on organizational health and execution and sits on company boards.
interesting_fact: Salesloft, which he co-founded and served as President, was acquired by Vista Equity Partners in December 2021 for $2.3B.
deep_cut_fact: Before Salesloft he co-founded HireIQ, a call-center hiring and machine-learning analytics company, serving as its CTO; it was later acquired by Verint Systems.
notes: Faith-driven entrepreneur active in the Praxis network; LinkedIn is the best published route. Board roles (Grayscale, Hubstaff) per aggregators, unverified on primary sources.
